title: Demographic Predicate
description: Portable age and gender audience targeting. At least one named dimension is required; dimensions compose with AND. Age retains inclusive integer bounds and independent unknown-age membership. Gender uses an unordered set of selected values and independent unknown-gender membership.

gender.description: Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.gender_targeting). AdCP 3.2 core remains age-only.
